% 25 small pages, for the default page limit (first 20 pages). Page N shows
% a black rule N bp wide (no fonts, to keep the PDF small).
% Built with plain pdfTeX by ../regenerate.sh (reproducible: no dates / IDs).
\pdfinfoomitdate=1
\pdftrailerid{}
\pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1
\pdfcompresslevel=9
\pdfobjcompresslevel=2
\nopagenumbers
\parindent=0pt
\hoffset=-1in \voffset=-1in
\pdfpagewidth=72bp \pdfpageheight=72bp
\hsize=72bp \vsize=72bp
\count255=0
\loop
  \advance\count255 by 1
  \vbox to 72bp{\vss\hbox to 72bp{\hss\vrule width \count255 bp height 10bp\hss}\vss}\eject
\ifnum\count255<25 \repeat
\bye
